init.title: Configure Family Link
init.description: Adjust integration settings. Changes will take effect after saving.

data.strict_mode: Strict mode (Home Assistant enforces the limits)

data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from Google (30-3600 seconds)
data_description.enable_location_tracking: When enabled, each location poll may send a notification to the child's device
data_description.strict_mode: Strict mode closes a gap on Google's side that many children know how to use: from the Family Link app or the Google interface, a supervised child can give themselves a time bonus, unlock a device that has no time left, or switch bedtime and the daily limit off. With strict mode on, Home Assistant becomes the single point of control: after every refresh it reverts those changes and overrides the Family Link settings with what you set from Home Assistant. WARNING: while it is on, manage Family Link from Home Assistant only, changes made in the Family Link app are undone. Turn the child's Strict Mode switch off to hand control back to Google.
data_description.strict_mode_rules: Which changes strict mode reverts. Nothing is switched on by force: the state in force when strict mode starts is the reference, and only Home Assistant can change it.

user.title: Google Family Link
user.description: Choose how to connect to the Family Link Auth service.

manual_url.title: Authentication Server URL
manual_url.description:
No local authentication source was detected. Please enter the URL of your Family Link Auth container.

Example: `http://192.168.1.100:8099` or `http://familylink-auth:8099`

If the auth server requires an API key (auth container v1.7.0+), append it to the URL: `http://192.168.1.100:8099?api_key=<key>` (key in the container's `data/api_key` file).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to authentication server. Please verify the URL and ensure the container is running.
error.invalid_auth: No cookies found. Please authenticate first using the Family Link Auth add-on or container.
error.no_cookies: Server is reachable but no cookies found. Please authenticate first via the web interface.
error.invalid_api_key: The server requires an API key. Append ?api_key=<key> to the URL, where <key> is the value of the API_KEY environment variable set on the auth container.

options.lock: Device lock follows Home Assistant (a lock or unlock done on the Google side is reverted; an unlock that bypasses an active bedtime, school time or reached daily limit is locked again until the restriction ends)
options.bedtime: Bedtime cannot be changed from Family Link (the state chosen in Home Assistant is put back)
options.daily_limit: The daily limit cannot be changed from Family Link (the state chosen in Home Assistant is put back)
options.school_time: School time cannot be changed from Family Link (the state chosen in Home Assistant is put back)
options.values: Bedtime hours and the daily limit cannot be changed from Family Link (the values chosen in Home Assistant are put back)
